title.en: Introduction to data: importance and types

hook.en: Every time you pay by UPI, book a bus ticket or post a photo, some data about you is recorded. What is all this data, and why does everyone want it?
hook.kn: ನೀವು UPI ಮೂಲಕ ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದಾಗ, ಬಸ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದಿರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಫೋಟೋ ಹಾಕಿದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ದಾಖಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಏನು, ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇದು ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು?

objectives.en: Explain why data matters for decision making
Distinguish structured and unstructured data, and explain metadata

narration.en: Every time you pay by UPI, book a bus ticket or post a photo, some data about you is recorded. What is all this data, and why does everyone want it?
narration.kn: ನೀವು UPI ಮೂಲಕ ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದಾಗ, ಬಸ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಾಯ್ದಿರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಫೋಟೋ ಹಾಕಿದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ದಾಖಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಏನು, ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇದು ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು?

body.en: Data is a collection of characters, numbers and other symbols that represent values of some situation or variable. Data in its raw form is not very useful; when it is processed it gives information that helps us make decisions. Banks, hospitals, shops and governments collect data to plan, forecast and serve people better.

points.en: Raw facts = data; processed meaningful data = information
Data supports decision-making, e.g. stocking a shop before a festival

narration.en: Data is raw facts: numbers, characters and symbols. When we process it, it becomes information that helps us take better decisions.
narration.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳು: ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು, ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಕೇತಗಳು. ಅದನ್ನು ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಉತ್ತಮ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯಕವಾದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Structured and unstructured data

say.en: Raw data alone tells us little. Here are the marks of five students in a table.
Processing turns it into information we can act on: the class average, the topper, who needs help.
This table is structured data: fixed rows (records) and columns (attributes). It is easy to search and sort.
Photos, audio, videos, e-mails and social media posts have no fixed format: unstructured data. Most data in the world is unstructured.

narration.en: We turn a marks table into useful information and compare structured data with unstructured data.

text.en: A marks table of a class
A spreadsheet of monthly electricity bills
A bank's table of account balances
A photo of a lab experiment
A social media post with comments

explanation.en: Structured data has a fixed format of records and attributes, so it is easy to search and sort. Images, audio, video, e-mail text and posts have no predefined format.
explanation.kn: ರಚಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ದಾಖಲೆ-ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ನಿಗದಿತ ರೂಪವಿದೆ. ಚಿತ್ರ, ಧ್ವನಿ, ವೀಡಿಯೊ, ಇ-ಮೇಲ್ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.

body.en: Structured data is organised in a fixed format, usually rows (records) and columns (attributes), like a marks table or a railway reservation chart. Unstructured data has no predefined format: images, audio, video, e-mails, web pages and social media posts. Unstructured data is described using metadata, i.e. data about data, such as the size, type, author and date of a file.

points.en: Unstructured: images, video, audio, documents, e-mails

narration.en: Structured data sits neatly in rows and columns. Unstructured data, like photos and videos, has no fixed format, so we describe it with metadata, which is data about data.
narration.kn: ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಾಲು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲಂಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಫೋಟೋ, ವೀಡಿಯೊಗಳಂತಹ ರಚನಾರಹಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ರೂಪವಿಲ್ಲ; ಅದನ್ನು ಮೆಟಾಡೇಟಾ ಮೂಲಕ, ಅಂದರೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಿಂದ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ.

problem.en: Classify each as structured or unstructured: (i) a school attendance spreadsheet, (ii) a recorded lecture video, (iii) the e-mails in your inbox, (iv) a table of electricity bills.

steps.en: (i) Attendance spreadsheet: fixed rows and columns → structured.
(ii) Lecture video: no row-column format → unstructured (described by metadata such as duration and size).
(iv) Electricity bill table: consumer number, units, amount in columns → structured.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Classify each as structured or unstructured: (i) a school attendance spreadsheet, (ii) a recorded lecture video, (iii) the e-mails in your inbox, (iv) a table of electricity bills.

problem.en: A photo on your phone shows: 'IMG_2041.jpg, 3.2 MB, 4000 × 3000, taken 12-08-2026, Mysuru'. Identify the data and the metadata.

steps.en: The pixels of the image are the actual (unstructured) data.
File name, size, resolution, date and location describe the image.
Data that describes other data is metadata.

answer.en: Image pixels = data; name, size, resolution, date, place = metadata.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A photo on your phone shows: 'IMG_2041.jpg, 3.2 MB, 4000 × 3000, taken 12-08-2026, Mysuru'. Identify the data and the metadata.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Read each one carefully before you answer.

points.en: Data is raw facts; processed data is information.
points.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಸಂಗತಿ; ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವೇ ಮಾಹಿತಿ.

points.en: Data helps organisations take informed decisions.
points.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Structured data has rows and columns; unstructured data has no fixed format.
points.kn: ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಲು-ಕಾಲಂ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ; ರಚನಾರಹಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ರೂಪವಿಲ್ಲ.

homework.en: List five examples each of structured and unstructured data from your daily life.

narration.en: Recap. Data is raw facts; processed data is information. Data helps organisations take informed decisions. Structured data has rows and columns; unstructured data has no fixed format. Metadata is data about data.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಸಂಗತಿ; ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವೇ ಮಾಹಿತಿ. ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಲು-ಕಾಲಂ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ; ರಚನಾರಹಿತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ರೂಪವಿಲ್ಲ. ಮೆಟಾಡೇಟಾ ಎಂದರೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ.
